The Poison:
Using criminal acts as a pretext for political visibility creates chaos without offering solutions.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Plane Error: WHAT vs WHY. The act was physical damage, but the pretext was political activism.

Social Physics Analysis:
Daniel Thomas executed a Smart Selfish Maneuver. He used the pretext of activism to mask a goal of personal notoriety, projecting political conflict while actively disrupting the life-saving work of rescue crews.

The Trajectory: The Path of Fall into Destruction.
When mapping the gap between the claim of activism and the reality of criminal damage, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. The energy was spent destroying rather than building.

The Unavoidable Truth: True activism builds capacity; criminal damage only builds notoriety.

The Unavoidable Lie: Chaos in the name of justice is merely chaos.
